wrongRootNativeProbe.reason: Browser control blocked direct cursor:// navigation and explicitly disallowed alternate-surface workarounds before the URI reached Cursor.
wrongRootNativeProbe.sourceObservation: The extension URI handler compares the incoming canonical root with the opened root before source opening or update handoff; native behavior remains unverified.

limits: The browser Update button prepares a chat draft; sending the draft is still required.
The publisher negative control is local and does not verify an installed-agent failure state or cancellation.

This does not verify wrong-root or moved-file recovery, reading return, VS Code source links on the same cut, learning-data preservation, normal-zoom visual comparison, or the nine-project acceptance matrix.
